meta.name: ai-ml-governance
meta.description: Governs models and AI systems in production — intended use, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, documentation, and the decision to deploy or retire. Use this before deploying a model or AI feature, when defining evaluation criteria, when a model's behavior has drifted, when assessing AI risk or regulatory exposure, or when deciding whether an AI system is fit for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规范AI模型治理,把控上线风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责AI系统的合规与风险评估
copy.tagline_en: Govern AI models with clear oversight
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own AI compliance and risk decisions

howto.what: 它会引导你完成治理流程:先定义预期用途与排除范围,再决定后果等级(咨询/辅助/自主),并给出评估、监控、人工监督、文档和退役的做法;涉敏感决策会提醒联系法务与风控。
howto.when: 当你要部署或停用模型、定义评估标准或判断AI是否适合重大决策时触发。

say.text: 我要上线一个信贷审批模型,该怎么定它的用途边界?
say.note: 会先引导你写预期用途、排除范围和后果等级。

say.text: 这个模型准确率不低,但某群体经常被误判,怎么评估?
say.note: 会让你按群体分段评估,并同时看假阳性和假阴性。

say.text: 模型监控发现人工干预率上升,接下来怎么办?
say.note: 会当早期警告,建议查输入漂移和重审流程。

howto.what_en: Guides you through governance: define intended use and exclusions, set the consequence tier, and follow practices for evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, documentation, and retirement. For sensitive decisions, tells you to involve Legal & Risk.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan to deploy or retire a model, define evaluation criteria, or judge whether an AI system is fit for a consequential decision.

say_en.text: I'm launching a credit approval model. How should I define its scope?
say_en.note: Guides you to write intended use, exclusions, and consequence tier.

say_en.text: This model is accurate but often misjudges one group. How do we evaluate it?
say_en.note: Asks for segment-level evaluation and both error directions.

say_en.text: Human override rate is rising. What should I do?
say_en.note: Treats it as an early warning; checks input drift and review process.
